text:
Type: armless plastic dining chair
Use: dining, working at a desk; kitchen, dining room, kids' room, café corner
Style: modern, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: molded reinforced polypropylene plastic, matte finish
Colors: bright sunny yellow
Shape: curved rectangular backrest on slim rear posts, smooth flat seat, four straight slightly tapered legs, clean lines, compact and light
Feel: cheerful, bold, playful, fresh
Goes with: white tables, light wood, grey or white walls; colorful modern kitchens, kids' rooms, Scandinavian dining spaces

product.name: JANINGE
product.description: You can stack the chairs, so they take less space when you're not using them.
